content.text:
Here is a concise map of where **調課** lives, what disables it, and how **roles / API** interact. --- ## 1. Where the 調課 UI is implemented | Location | What it is | |----------|------------| | `/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/SmartCalendar.vue` | Main calendar: **「🔄 調課」** opens `openRescheduleModal`; separate **調課** modal and `submitReschedule`; drag-drop uses same form + modal. | | `/home/admin/frontend/src/components/course-management/SessionEditModal.vue` | **「調課」** in **單堂檢視** menu → `start-reschedule` flow; **「確認調課」** in reschedule sub-view. | | `/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/CourseManagement.vue` | Wires `SessionEditModal`, `RescheduleModal`, `MakeupSlotsModal`, composables; 調課 from **clicking a session chip** → `openSessionEdit` (not a standalone row button). | | `/home/admin/frontend/src/components/course-management/RescheduleModal.vue` | Course-level modal (pick session date + new date/time). | | `/home/admin/frontend/src/composables/course-management/useRescheduleAndMakeup.js` | `openReschedule`, `submitReschedule`, session options, makeup slots. | | `/home/admin/frontend/src/composables/course-management/useSessionEditFlow.js` | `startSessionReschedule`, `doSessionReschedule` (session chip path). | | `/home/admin/frontend/src/components/substitute/SubstituteTeacherPickerModal.vue` | **「同時調整上課時間」** (optional reschedule with substitute), not the primary 調課 button. | **Note:** In `CourseManagement.vue`, `openReschedule` is taken from `useRescheduleAndMakeup` but **nothing in the repo calls `openReschedule(`** except the composable definition. The live path is **session chip → `SessionEditModal` → 調課**. `RescheduleModal` is still mounted and can be opened if `showRescheduleModal` is set elsewhere (e.g. makeup slot selection — check `selectMakeupSlot` in composable). --- ## 2. Exact button markup and **disabled** / visibility rules **SmartCalendar — toolbar 調課 (not disabled in template):** ```402:414:/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/SmartCalendar.vue
單堂操作
``` - **調課:** no `:disabled`. - **換代課老師:** hidden when `isTeacher` (`userRole === 'teacher'`). **SmartCalendar — 確認調課 in modal (also not disabled):** ```817:820:/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/SmartCalendar.vue
``` Guard is only inside `submitReschedule` (e.g. `if (!rescheduleForm.value.new_date) { alert('請選擇新日期'); return; }`). **SessionEditModal — 調課 (menu) and 確認調課:** ```19:33:/home/admin/frontend/src/components/course-management/SessionEditModal.vue

單堂操作

... ``` ```95:98:/home/admin/frontend/src/components/course-management/SessionEditModal.vue
``` - **調課:** always shown in `mode === 'menu'` (no `canTransition` guard). - **確認調課:** `:disabled="submitting || !form.new_date"`. **RescheduleModal — 確認調課:** ```53:56:/home/admin/frontend/src/components/course-management/RescheduleModal.vue
``` If `sessionOptions.length === 0`, the template shows a hint and **no** submit row in the `v-else` branch (only the empty state). **Reaching the SmartCalendar modal:** the 調課 button sits in `showModal && editingCourseId`. Course cards use `@click.stop="!isTeacher && onCourseClick(...)"`, so **teachers do not open this modal via grid click** (read-only / no-click styling is applied when `isTeacher`). --- ## 3. Recent changes (git) From the repo history: - `SessionEditModal.vue`: last touches include `1d451c6` (*session charge auto-calc…*), `ba1b48d` (*batch commit ui and workflow updates*), `ca73dbd` (*chore: sync…*). - Broader calendar/workflow: `b5856e2` (*RWD / 智慧排課*), `64feb97` (*核准評量=點名核課*), etc. There is **no commit message that only mentions「調課」button disable logic**; to see exact diffs use e.g. `git show 1d451c6 -- frontend/src/components/course-management/SessionEditModal.vue`. --- ## 4. Permissions / role-based behavior **Frontend (shell):** - **課程管理** is mounted only for directors (and similar): `CourseManagement` → `v-if="... isDirector && active === 'course-mgmt'"` in `/home/admin/frontend/src/App.vue` (~line 290). - **行事曆** is available to both director and teacher, but **teacher** calendar disables slot/course clicks and drag (`!isTeacher && onCourseClick`, `draggable="!isTeacher"`, etc.), so the **單堂檢視** modal (and its 調課 row) is effectively **not reachable by normal teacher interaction** on the grid. - **代課** button in that modal is explicitly **`v-if="!isTeacher"`**. **Backend:** - `POST /api/v1/learning-records/reschedule-session` is registered inside `Route::middleware(['role:director', ...])` in `/home/admin/backend/routes/api.php` (director-only group starting ~167). `RequireRole` **allows `super_admin` to bypass**; otherwise the user’s `auth_role` must be **`director`** for that middleware (not `teacher`). - `POST /api/v1/schedules` (used in composables when writing `status: 'rescheduled'`) sits in the **`role:director,teacher`** group (~269), with extra rules in `ScheduleController` for teachers (e.g. `teacher_id` must match the authenticated teacher). So: **UI for full calendar 調課 is aimed at non-teacher users who can open the course modal; the final session sync often calls `reschedule-session`, which is director-scoped at the route level.** Teachers still have narrower schedule APIs but do not get the same calendar edit path in the current Vue code. --- ### Files to keep on your short list - `/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/SmartCalendar.vue` — 調課 button, modal, `submitReschedule`, drag reschedule, `isTeacher` gating. - `/home/admin/frontend/src/components/course-management/SessionEditModal.vue` — 調課 + disabled **確認調課**. - `/home/admin/frontend/src/components/course-management/RescheduleModal.vue` — disabled **確認調課** + empty session options. - `/home/admin/frontend/src/pages/CourseManagement.vue` — session chip → modal wiring. - `/home/admin/frontend/src/composables/course-management/useRescheduleAndMakeup.js` - `/home/admin/frontend/src/composables/course-management/useSessionEditFlow.js` - `/home/admin/frontend/src/App.vue` — `isDirector` / `CourseManagement` vs `SmartCalendar`. - `/home/admin/backend/routes/api.php` — middleware groups for `reschedule-session` vs `schedules`. - `/home/admin/backend/app/Http/Middleware/RequireRole.php` — `super_admin` bypass. - `/home/admin/backend/app/Http/Controllers/LearningRecordController.php` — `rescheduleSession`.
